messages:
maria (AE): FYI — Helios Labs POC asking for a 6mo dedicated commit with autoscale + burst. They want a blended GPU rate and a temporary higher burst cap. Need deal desk pricing/approval.
ben (SE): Which GPUs? steady-state and burst mix?
kai (Sales Eng): Quick note: common ask is 4xA100 steady -> burst to 8xA100. Autoscale trigger on queue depth.
maria (AE): Correct — they want 4 reserved A100 equiv, burst to 8 for 1–3 hrs/day during testing windows. Proposed commit: $120k/mo for 6 months. Customer asking for ~$3.5/GPU-hr blended.
lee (Finance): Heads up — $3.5/GPU-hr is below our 6mo reserved floor for A100. Floor is $4.2/GPU-hr. With a modest promo we can do $3.9/GPU-hr but need revenue ops signoff.
jordan (Deals Desk): Also need exact burst billing rule. We normally apply a multiplier on base rate (e.g., 1.6–1.8x) for burst usage and a daily burst cap to bound exposure. Do we have autoscale caps in the SOW?
ben (SE): Tech ops suggests: base pool = 4 A100 equiv, burst multiplier = 1.6x, burst cap = +100% (i.e., up to 8) limited to 2 hours/day by policy. If they need >2 hours/day we can add extra committed buffer.
maria (AE): Customer insists on $3.5. Will accept onboarding credit. Any levers to bring price down without impacting runway?
lee (Finance): We can offer a one-time onboarding credit up to $20k and a 7% off the base blended rate, but blended can't go below $3.8 after credit. Also require minimum committed spend (the $120k/mo qualifies).
kai (Sales Eng): Another optimization: recommend model quantization + batching advisory during POC to reduce effective GPU-hours. Put that in the SOW as a deliverable — helps justify a smaller discount.
jordan (Deals Desk): Draft provisional term set: commit $120k/mo x 6, base blended $3.9/GPU-hr, burst multiplier 1.6x (applied to base), burst cap 2h/day. One-time onboarding credit $20k applied against first invoice. Exception requires approvals from finance lead.
maria (AE): Can we get provisional sign-off so I can share with customer today? They want official numbers to move the contract.
lee (Finance): Provisionally yes pending final review by RevOps. I’ll loop in revops but make it explicit: no lower than $3.8 effective rate after credits; bursts billed at 1.6x; any sustained >2h/day bursts convert to a short-term overage charge/auto-escalation.
ben (SE): Also note technical caveat: If they run long KV-cache heavy chat flows, effective throughput drops; we should attach an ops note: recommended request shaping and prefix caching config. Drop a snippet in SOW.
maria (AE): dropping SOW snippet now.
ben (SE): ```
// SOW: POC burst policy (example)
base_pool: 4xA100_equiv
burst_limit: 8xA100_equiv
burst_mult: 1.6
daily_burst_window: 2h
deliverables: quantization + batching playbook, ops runbook
```
kai (Sales Eng): Looks good. Add clause: "Customer may request up to one temporary burst extension (48h) during POC with prior approval; additional extensions billed at burst rate + 10%"
jordan (Deals Desk): We'll include that. Also need a short security/ops checklist for Private vs Hosted; customer asked about data residency. Maria, confirm deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated private VPC).
maria (AE): They want dedicated but hosted within our EU region (data residency required).
lee (Finance): EU region has slightly higher infra cost — factor ~+6% to unit economics; adjust internal approval.
jordan (Deals Desk): Noted. I’ll assemble a final term sheet: commit $120k/mo for 6mo, base $3.9/GPU-hr, burst 1.6x, 2h/day cap, one-time $20k credit, EU-region premium applied to internal math. Needs RevOps + Legal signoff for exception.
deals-bot: Approval requested -> deals/jordan assigned reviewers: revops, legal, finance.
maria (AE): Thanks — I’ll hold off customer commit until we have approval. :thumbsup:
lee (Finance): I’ll start the revops thread. Please attach expected usage curve (hourly), and any security checklist answers.
kai (Sales Eng): Happy to provide usage estimate and ops notes.
ben (SE): I’ll add the technical runbook and batching configs.
maria (AE): Great — keep me posted. If revops approves, I’ll send the LOI and schedule kickoff.
jordan (Deals Desk): Will update thread when reviewers sign. :white_check_mark:
